properties.name: Puñaka Tinta María
properties.description: One of the three Uru communities of Lake Poopó, located on the eastern banks of the lake. Home to the Cooperativa de Artesanías formed in 2017.

properties.name: Vilañeque
properties.description: An Uru community situated on the shores of Lake Poopó, known for its deep connection to the lacustrine culture and fishing traditions.

properties.name: Llapallapani
properties.description: The third of the three Uru communities of Lake Poopó, engaged in small-scale agriculture and artisan crafts as the lake has receded.
